app.title: DreamDraft
app.tagline: Build your dream squad. Draft. Compete.

common.error: Something went wrong. Is the API running?

players.heading: Player pool
players.error: Couldn't load players. Is the API running?

gameVersion.question: Which game version?
gameVersion.hint: Decides which player pool the draft uses.

mode.question: Match or tournament?
mode.tournamentDesc: Several teams, fixtures after the draft.

tournament.question: Tournament setup
tournament.uclDesc: Everyone plays everyone, then the top finishers go into a bracket. The knockout rounds are two-legged, the final is a single game.
tournament.note: The fixtures are drawn at random. You enter the scores; the table and the bracket keep themselves up to date.
tournament.legsDoubleDesc: Home and away; the aggregate score decides. Level on aggregate goes to penalties.
tournament.uclTooFew: The Champions League needs at least {{min}} teams — below that the league phase sends nobody home.

participants.question: Who is drafting?
participants.hint: Names are used on the wheel and on the squads.
participants.locked: The tournament team count sets how many participants there are.
participants.duplicate: Two participants cannot have the same name.

order.question: How is the pick order decided?
order.watchDesc: A random draw, one slot at a time.
order.manualDesc: No draw — you arrange who picks first.

style.question: How are players picked?
style.randomTeamsDesc: Every pick rolls a random club; you pick from its squad.
style.yourChoiceDesc: Pick anyone from the whole pool.
style.randomPositionDesc: Each pick gives you a position and a rating range.
style.gamblerDesc: A formation is drawn, the eleven is filled slot by slot and the substitutes come at random. You pick nothing.

size.question: How many players per team?
size.poolWarning: Not enough players in the pool for this setup.

randomTeams.question: Random Teams rules
randomTeams.hint: A random club is rolled for every single pick.
randomTeams.rerolls: How many times can a player change the team?
randomTeams.repeat: Can the same team come up again?
randomTeams.repeatOffDesc: A club that came up for you never comes up for you again.
randomTeams.repeatOnDesc: The same club can come up again until you hit your player limit for it.
randomTeams.notEnoughClubs: Not enough clubs: {{needed}} needed, {{available}} in the pool.
randomTeams.rerollsHint: On your turn a random club is rolled and you pick from its squad. Don't like the club? Use one of these to change it for another random one. When they run out you have to pick from whatever club comes up. Everyone gets this many for the whole draft.

yourChoice.question: How many from one club?
yourChoice.hint: You pick the players freely; the only limit is how many may come from a single club.
yourChoice.noLimit: A whole squad may come from one club — no limit.
yourChoice.clubsNeeded: Building a squad needs at least {{clubs}} different clubs.

board.squadBanner: Pick from your random squad ({{count}} players)
board.rollHint: Roll a random team to see who you can pick from.
board.clubExhausted: You already took {{max}} players from this club — change the team, it won't cost a right.
board.clubLimitFull: You have filled the player limit for {{club}} ({{max}}) — pick from another club.
board.clubLimitBanner: At most {{max}} players from the same club.

results.title: Squads
results.tournamentNote: Squads are set. The fixtures will be drawn at random.

tournament.penaltyQuestion: Level on aggregate — who won on penalties?
tournament.bracketHint: Enter the scores; winners move up the bracket on their own.
tournament.qualifyNote: The top {{top}} go through to the knockout phase. {{remaining}} games left.
tournament.leagueDone: League phase over — the bracket is seeded by the table.

pitch.openHint: See the squad on the pitch
pitch.pickPlayer: Now pick a player from the list.
